name: Liberthea Anadara
about:
My work is about restoring clear perception in a world that profits from distortion.

I help people recognize the signals they've been taught to override — emotions, body responses, repeating patterns, and timing. So they can orient themselves without needing external authority.

I'm not here to tell you what to believe or who to become. I'm here to remove the interference so what's already true becomes visible again.

Astrology is one of the tools I use. Your chart shows your purpose, your gifts, your shadows, and the emotions you struggle with. Not the surface stuff — the real map.
